name: Anime details
author: Lichtspiel
description: Finds anime on AniList (no key needed) and adds the AniList score, links to AniList and MyAnimeList and the animation studio; if you like, also AniList's title and summary (in English). Settings: libraries to use it for by name (e.g. ["Anime"]; none = every title whose original title is Japanese and that is animated), title ("romaji", "english", "native" or "" to keep the title), summary ("missing" = only when there is none, "always", "never"), studio (the animation studio instead of the TV channel), genres (AniList's genres, in English).
